authoring: AI 撰寫的學習內容；詞形參考 ECDICT。非官方試題。

entries.en: a building used to store goods

examples.en: The boxes are stored in our warehouse.
examples.zh: 這些箱子存放在我們的倉庫。

entries.en: an expected level of quality

examples.en: All products meet our safety standard.
examples.zh: 所有產品都符合我們的安全標準。

entries.en: the smallest amount allowed or required

examples.en: A minimum of ten orders is required.
examples.zh: 至少需要十筆訂單。

entries.en: money planned for a particular purpose

examples.en: Our budget covers the necessary repairs.
examples.zh: 我們的預算足以支付必要的修繕。

entries.en: a book explaining how to use something

examples.en: Consult the manual before installing the software.
examples.zh: 安裝軟體前請查閱手冊。

entries.en: something caused by an action or event

examples.en: We will publish the survey results tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天將公布調查結果。

entries.en: knowledge gained by doing something

examples.en: She has experience in customer service.
examples.zh: 她具有顧客服務的經驗。

entries.en: a document with spaces for information

examples.en: Please complete this application form.
examples.zh: 請填妥這份申請表。

entries.en: a planned visit around a place

examples.en: The factory tour starts at ten.
examples.zh: 工廠參觀活動十點開始。

entries.en: a prize given for achievement

examples.en: Our team received an innovation award.
examples.zh: 我們團隊獲得了創新獎。

entries.en: money paid to the government

examples.en: The price does not include sales tax.
examples.zh: 這個價格不含營業稅。

entries.en: a reduction in the usual price

examples.en: Members receive a ten percent discount.
examples.zh: 會員享有九折優惠。

entries.en: a result that someone aims to achieve

examples.en: We reached our monthly sales target.
examples.zh: 我們達成了本月銷售目標。

entries.en: an act of asking for something

examples.en: Your request for leave was approved.
examples.zh: 你的請假申請已獲核准。

entries.en: the result you hope to achieve

examples.en: The aim is to reduce waiting times.
examples.zh: 目的是縮短等候時間。

entries.en: the buying and selling of goods

examples.en: International trade supports the local economy.
examples.zh: 國際貿易支持了當地經濟。

entries.en: an arrangement of things for people to see

examples.en: The window display features new products.
examples.zh: 櫥窗展示了新產品。

entries.en: energy used to operate machines

examples.en: A storm interrupted the power supply.
examples.zh: 暴風雨造成電力供應中斷。

entries.en: help given to someone in need

examples.en: The fund provides aid to small businesses.
examples.zh: 這項基金援助小型企業。

entries.en: money returned after a purchase

examples.en: We issued a refund for the damaged item.
examples.zh: 我們已為受損商品辦理退款。

entries.en: not having enough of something

examples.en: A lack of space delayed the expansion.
examples.zh: 空間不足延誤了擴建。

entries.en: a series of actions leading to a result

examples.en: The application process takes three days.
examples.zh: 申請流程需要三天。

entries.en: money borrowed and paid back later

examples.en: The bank approved our business loan.
examples.zh: 銀行核准了我們的企業貸款。

entries.en: the amount people want to buy

examples.en: Demand for electric vehicles is growing.
examples.zh: 電動車的需求正在成長。

entries.en: movement toward completing or improving something

examples.en: The project is making steady progress.
examples.zh: 這項專案正穩定推進。

entries.en: a connected group of people or systems

examples.en: Our distribution network covers the entire island.
examples.zh: 我們的配送網絡遍及全島。

entries.en: a set of questions used to collect information

examples.en: Customers can complete a short survey.
examples.zh: 顧客可以填寫一份簡短問卷。

entries.en: a group of related products or values

examples.en: We offer a wide range of services.
examples.zh: 我們提供廣泛的服務。

entries.en: a test used to learn or prove something

examples.en: The experiment tested a new packaging material.
examples.zh: 這項實驗測試了一種新包裝材料。

entries.en: something bought at a good price

examples.en: This refurbished laptop is a real bargain.
examples.zh: 這台整修過的筆電真的很划算。

entries.en: an early version of a document

examples.en: Please review the first draft.
examples.zh: 請審閱初稿。

entries.en: careful study to discover information

examples.en: Market research helps us understand customers.
examples.zh: 市場研究有助於我們了解顧客。

entries.en: an increase in pay

examples.en: She received a raise after her review.
examples.zh: 她在考核後獲得加薪。

entries.en: a planned piece of work

examples.en: The project must finish by June.
examples.zh: 這項專案必須在六月前完成。

entries.en: not open or available to everyone

examples.en: The discussion will take place in private.
examples.zh: 這場討論將私下進行。

entries.en: belonging or relating to one person

examples.en: Do not share your personal password.
examples.zh: 請勿分享你的個人密碼。

entries.en: happening often or shared by several people

examples.en: Payment delays are a common problem.
examples.zh: 付款延遲是常見的問題。

entries.en: happening at usual or repeated times

examples.en: Regular maintenance prevents unexpected breakdowns.
examples.zh: 定期維護能預防意外故障。

entries.en: important or large in effect

examples.en: The new office is near a major station.
examples.zh: 新辦公室靠近主要車站。

entries.en: ready for use or free to meet

examples.en: A meeting room is available this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午有會議室可用。

entries.en: expressing an unfavorable opinion or result

examples.en: We responded to the negative feedback.
examples.zh: 我們回應了負面意見。

entries.en: lasting for a limited time

examples.en: We hired temporary staff for the festival.
examples.zh: 我們為節慶活動聘用了臨時人員。

entries.en: most important or coming first

examples.en: Safety is our primary concern.
examples.zh: 安全是我們最主要的考量。

entries.en: usual for a particular type

examples.en: A typical delivery takes two days.
examples.zh: 一般配送需要兩天。

entries.en: small in amount or availability

examples.en: Parking spaces are limited near the office.
examples.zh: 辦公室附近的停車位有限。

entries.en: relating to the body or real objects

examples.en: The job requires some physical strength.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要一定的體力。

entries.en: happening once every year

examples.en: Our annual meeting is in September.
examples.zh: 我們的年度會議在九月舉行。

entries.en: happening many times

examples.en: Frequent checks help prevent mistakes.
examples.zh: 頻繁檢查有助於預防錯誤。

entries.en: of several different types

examples.en: We considered various payment options.
examples.zh: 我們考慮了各種付款方式。

entries.en: right for a particular purpose

examples.en: This room is suitable for small meetings.
examples.zh: 這個房間適合小型會議。

entries.en: useful and suited to real situations

examples.en: The workshop provides practical advice.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊提供實用建議。

entries.en: expected or required at a certain time

examples.en: The final payment is due Friday.
examples.zh: 尾款須在星期五支付。

entries.en: allowed by law or relating to law

examples.en: Please seek legal advice before signing.
examples.zh: 簽署前請先尋求法律建議。

entries.en: following customs used for a long time

examples.en: The restaurant serves traditional Taiwanese dishes.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應傳統台灣料理。

entries.en: easy to carry or move

examples.en: We need a portable projector.
examples.zh: 我們需要一台可攜式投影機。

entries.en: likely to cause damage or injury

examples.en: The chemical may be harmful to plants.
examples.zh: 這種化學物質可能對植物有害。

entries.en: including every part

examples.en: The entire team attended the briefing.
examples.zh: 整個團隊都參加了簡報會。

entries.en: not changing suddenly or unexpectedly

examples.en: Prices have remained stable this month.
examples.zh: 本月價格維持穩定。

entries.en: expecting good things to happen

examples.en: Investors are optimistic about future growth.
examples.zh: 投資人對未來成長抱持樂觀態度。

entries.en: able to do something well

examples.en: She is capable of managing the project.
examples.zh: 她有能力管理這項專案。

entries.en: not expected to happen

examples.en: A further delay is unlikely.
examples.zh: 不太可能再延誤。

entries.en: giving many facts or explanations

examples.en: Please provide a detailed cost estimate.
examples.zh: 請提供詳細的費用估算。

entries.en: easy to notice or understand

examples.en: The benefits of the upgrade are obvious.
examples.zh: 這次升級的好處很明顯。

entries.en: knowing that something exists or happens

examples.en: Are you aware of the new policy?
examples.zh: 你知道這項新政策嗎？

entries.en: relating to a nearby area

examples.en: We buy vegetables from local farmers.
examples.zh: 我們向當地農民購買蔬菜。

entries.en: existing first or created independently

examples.en: Please keep the original receipt.
examples.zh: 請保留原始收據。

entries.en: kept for use when needed

examples.en: A spare key is at reception.
examples.zh: 接待處有一把備用鑰匙。

entries.en: being at a place or existing now

examples.en: All department heads were present.
examples.zh: 所有部門主管都出席了。

entries.en: protected against danger or unauthorized access

examples.en: Keep customer records in a secure location.
examples.zh: 請將顧客紀錄存放在安全的地方。

entries.en: happening at the beginning

examples.en: The initial inspection found no damage.
examples.zh: 初步檢查沒有發現損壞。

entries.en: without waiting or delay

examples.en: Report any equipment damage immediately.
examples.zh: 設備若有損壞請立即通報。

entries.en: almost but not completely

examples.en: The renovation is nearly complete.
examples.zh: 整修工程幾乎完成了。

entries.en: to keep something for later or avoid waste

examples.en: This software will save us time.
examples.zh: 這套軟體能幫我們節省時間。

entries.en: to ask someone to attend or join

examples.en: We invited the supplier to lunch.
examples.zh: 我們邀請供應商共進午餐。

entries.en: to copy online data to a device

examples.en: Download the application from our website.
examples.zh: 請從我們的網站下載應用程式。

entries.en: to be present at an event

examples.en: All supervisors should attend the training.
examples.zh: 所有主管都應參加訓練。

entries.en: to decide that something will not happen

examples.en: We had to cancel the outdoor event.
examples.zh: 我們不得不取消戶外活動。

entries.en: to help someone remember something

examples.en: Please remind me to send the invoice.
examples.zh: 請提醒我寄送發票。

entries.en: to examine similarities and differences

examples.en: Compare the prices before ordering.
examples.zh: 訂購前請比較價格。

entries.en: to take something to a person or place

examples.en: We deliver orders within three days.
examples.zh: 我們會在三天內配送訂單。

entries.en: to say you are sorry

examples.en: We apologize for the delivery delay.
examples.zh: 我們為配送延遲致歉。

entries.en: to take something away

examples.en: Remove the old label before shipping.
examples.zh: 出貨前請移除舊標籤。

entries.en: to plan an activity or arrange things

examples.en: Our team will organize the conference.
examples.zh: 我們團隊將籌辦這場會議。

entries.en: to make something new

examples.en: The expansion will create new jobs.
examples.zh: 這次擴建將創造新工作機會。

entries.en: to identify someone or acknowledge value

examples.en: The award recognizes outstanding customer service.
examples.zh: 這個獎項肯定傑出的顧客服務。

entries.en: to arrange to use something in advance

examples.en: Book your seat before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前預訂座位。

entries.en: to answer or react

examples.en: We respond to inquiries within one day.
examples.zh: 我們會在一天內回覆詢問。

entries.en: to speak or write briefly about something

examples.en: She mentioned the deadline during lunch.
examples.zh: 她在午餐時提到了截止日期。

entries.en: to find an amount using numbers

examples.en: Calculate the total cost before ordering.
examples.zh: 訂購前請計算總費用。

entries.en: to put equipment or software into use

examples.en: A technician will install the new printer.
examples.zh: 技術人員將安裝新印表機。

entries.en: to have something inside

examples.en: The package contains two replacement parts.
examples.zh: 包裹內有兩個替換零件。

entries.en: to be the same or go well together

examples.en: The invoice must match the purchase order.
examples.zh: 發票必須與採購單相符。

entries.en: to have enough money or time

examples.en: We cannot afford another production delay.
examples.zh: 我們無法再承受一次生產延誤。

entries.en: to help someone do something

examples.en: Our staff can assist with registration.
examples.zh: 我們的人員可以協助辦理報名。

entries.en: to make someone interested in something

examples.en: The discount should attract new customers.
examples.zh: 這項折扣應能吸引新顧客。

entries.en: to create or improve something over time

examples.en: We plan to develop a mobile application.
examples.zh: 我們計畫開發行動應用程式。

entries.en: to check or state that something is certain

examples.en: Please confirm your attendance by email.
examples.zh: 請以電子郵件確認是否出席。

entries.en: to ask formally or put something into use

examples.en: You can apply for the position online.
examples.zh: 你可以在線上應徵這個職缺。

entries.en: to make something smaller or lower

examples.en: The new process will reduce waste.
examples.zh: 新流程將減少浪費。

entries.en: to refuse to accept something

examples.en: The client rejected the first proposal.
examples.zh: 客戶拒絕了第一份提案。
